name: How often should siding be sealed or re-sealed?

mainEntity.name: How often should siding be sealed or re-sealed?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency for siding sealing depends on the type of siding, the sealant used, and exposure to weather elements. Generally, sealants can last anywhere from 5 to 15 years. Regular inspection for cracks, peeling, or signs of moisture intrusion can indicate when re-sealing is necessary. For homes in the Bay Area, where homes experience varying conditions, an annual inspection is recommended to determine the optimal re-sealing schedule and prevent potential damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Siding typically needs re-sealing every 5 to 15 years, depending on siding type and weather exposure. Annual inspections help determine the optimal schedule.
